name: Strezzy’s Apps
subtitle: Free iPhone apps by Strezzy
description: Download my iPhone apps and check for updates in LiveContainer. These are passion projects I make for myself and share for free.

apps.name: Music
apps.subtitle: Offline music player
apps.localizedDescription: Play music stored on your iPhone, browse albums, make playlists, and search your library. Change album artwork and choose optional scrolling animations in Settings.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds 15 optional scrolling animations in Settings.

apps.versionDescription: Adds 15 optional scrolling animations in Settings.

apps.name: VoiceGlass
apps.subtitle: Turn text into speech with your voice
apps.localizedDescription: Turn typed text into speech using a short voice recording. Record or import a sample, save voices, and export clips as WAV files. Download a model before using it offline. Voice generation in this release still needs testing on a real iPhone.

versions.localizedDescription: First release with saved voices, text-to-speech, clip playback, and WAV export. Models download separately. Voice generation still needs testing on a real iPhone.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Record a short voice sample on this iPhone.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Transcribe your voice sample on this iPhone so Qwen can match your voice. VoiceGlass requires on-device recognition; audio is not sent to a server.

apps.versionDescription: First release with saved voices, text-to-speech, clip playback, and WAV export. Models download separately. Voice generation still needs testing on a real iPhone.

apps.name: Prism
apps.subtitle: Generate and edit images with AI
apps.localizedDescription: Create images from a text description, or add reference pictures and describe the edits you want. Download a model before using it offline, then save and export images from the gallery. Image generation in this release still needs testing on a real iPhone.

versions.localizedDescription: First release with text-to-image generation, reference-image editing, a saved gallery, and image export. Models download separately. Image generation still needs testing on a real iPhone.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save the images you create in Prism to your photo library.

apps.versionDescription: First release with text-to-image generation, reference-image editing, a saved gallery, and image export. Models download separately. Image generation still needs testing on a real iPhone.

apps.name: Depth Check
apps.subtitle: Convert photos and videos to 3D
apps.localizedDescription: Convert photos and videos into 3D on your iPhone. Export Apple Spatial, side-by-side, over-under and other stereo formats at the original pixel dimensions and video frame timing. Includes two offline depth models. HDR video is converted to SDR.

versions.localizedDescription: Convert photos and videos to 3D on your iPhone. Fixes side-by-side exports stalling near the end, improves depth stability, and simplifies the interface. Keeps original pixel dimensions and video timing.
Depth Check 1.0: local photo and video depth conversion, full-resolution stereo exports, source video timing, native Liquid Glass. See the release notes for validation details.
Depth Check 1.0: local photo and video depth conversion, full-resolution stereo exports, source video timing, native Liquid Glass. See the release notes for validation details.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save the spatial photos and videos you create in Depth Check to Photos.

apps.versionDescription: Convert photos and videos to 3D on your iPhone. Fixes side-by-side exports stalling near the end, improves depth stability, and simplifies the interface. Keeps original pixel dimensions and video timing.
